description: Compare Grandet model prices within each unit. Read listings for price-only ordering and conditions; legacy recommended/alternative/cheapest retain their old meanings. Use view=compact for shared connection cards and a short text response. Provide exactly one model or name selector. host records the source only and never selects the inference route. Send targetApp when the user or conversation identifies the intended API application, including explicit use in the current app. With no target, compare directly. An unrecorded app connection permits a price-only recommendation, not a compatibility claim. Omit profile/protocol for a multi-protocol app unless already specified. Existing client remains a legacy target-app alias. Infer coding/chat/long_output from the task; presets are estimates. Use grandet_list_apps only when application facts are needed. Do not request API keys.

asOf.description: Evaluate as of this UTC time (ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-10-16T12:00:00Z"). Omit to evaluate now.

channel.description: "standard" (default) lists ordinary channels, "declared-nonstandard" only channels the site itself labels nonstandard, "all" both.

client.description: Legacy alias of targetApp. Prefer targetApp.

currency.description: Limit to one unit board: USD_CREDIT or CNY_CREDIT (site credit, not cash), USD or CNY (cash). Never compare prices across units.

endpointType.description: Limit to one API protocol. Send it only when the user named a protocol.

host.description: The assistant or app making this call, e.g. "claude-code" or "codex". Attribution only; it does not change results.

mix.description: Workload used to blend input, cache and output prices into one price per million total tokens. Presets "chat" (default), "coding" and "long_output", or custom input/cache-read/output/cache-write shares totalling 100.

model.description: Model to look up: a catalogue ID, an exact model name or a natural name such as "claude-sonnet-5-5". Send exactly one of model or name. An ambiguous name returns NEEDS_CLARIFICATION with candidates.

name.description: The catalogue's 20-character hexadecimal raw-name ID (not the name text). Send exactly one of model or name.

os.description: Operating system the target app runs on, for connection steps: windows, macos, linux or unknown.

plans.description: "best" (default) keeps one group per site; "all" lists every group of every site.

releaseSet.description: Pin a published data release by its release-set hash. Omit to use the current release.

skillBuild.description: Grandet Skill build ID when called from the Skill. Omit otherwise.

skillVersion.description: Grandet Skill version when called from the Skill, e.g. "0.3.0". Omit otherwise.

targetApp.description: Catalogue ID of the app that will use the API, e.g. "openclaw", "claude-code" or "codex". Selects compatible protocols and connection steps. Send it only when the user says where the API will be used.

targetProfile.description: An inference profile ID of the target app (see grandet_list_apps). Only together with targetApp or client.

view.description: "compact" (default): a short text summary plus the listings, with connection cards shared in integrationCards; about a third of the size. "full": every legacy field, with the whole JSON repeated as text.

name: grandet_find_cheapest_api
title: Find a suitable low-cost model API / 寻找便宜且适用的模型 API
